clauses.soak.no-counter-errors: REQUIREMENTS.md REQ-VER-06; issue #396 owner/assignment decisions; Milan v1.2 5.3.8.10 Table 5.6; IEEE 1722-2016 4.4.4.6: zero SEQ_NUM_MISMATCH, STREAM_INTERRUPTED, LATE_TIMESTAMP and EARLY_TIMESTAMP growth on every Stream Input, CRF included; zero MEDIA_UNLOCKED growth of any cause, explained or not, outside a recorded planted event; each planted event excuses at most one increment per input; a decrease is a counter reset and fails; graded by check_release_soak_counters; missing reads or a missing planted-event log is NOT RUN
clauses.soak.mr-causes-and-hold: REQUIREMENTS.md REQ-VER-06; issue #396 owner/assignment decisions; IEEE 1722-2016 4.4.4.3; Milan v1.2 Annex B.1.2, Tables 5.4/5.6: every mr toggle and MEDIA_RESET increment needs a recorded media-clock-source change, CRF disruption, or received CRF mr toggle mapped to that stream's clock source; GM change alone fails; match causes within +/- observation_resolution_s of the toggle; hold each new value for at least 8 AVTPDUs of that stream; MEDIA_RESET counts observation intervals, not packets; missing packet, cause, counter or resolution evidence is NOT RUN; each cause excuses at most one toggle per stream; 2 * observation_resolution_s must be less than the 1 s counter interval ceiling; capture must span [first read - 1 s - observation_resolution_s, last read]; a MEDIA_RESET decrease is a counter reset, not a wrap
clauses.soak.gptp-continuity: REQUIREMENTS.md REQ-VER-06; issue #396 owner/assignment decisions; Milan v1.2 4.2.6.2.4: coherent fabric publication reads and transition evidence prove no asCapable loss
clauses.soak.tu-within-holdover: REQUIREMENTS.md REQ-VER-06; issue #396 owner/assignment decisions; Milan v1.2 Annex B.1/B.1.1 / IEEE 1722-2016 4.4.4.7: each tu interval contains at least one recorded discontinuity: GM-identity edge, GM time-source change, or other detected gPTP discontinuity (including PHC settime/adjtime and fabric discontinuity); containment uses [observed_start - observation_resolution_s, clear); measure from the last recorded discontinuity before tu clears; it clears within 0.5 s plus the stated observation resolution; uncorrelated tu fails; resolution comes from wire capture and correlated event timestamps; it includes launch-to-capture latency and event-to-capture correlation error; after each GM change, clear + observation_resolution_s must be at least GM change + 0.25 s (Annex B.1.1 minimum); missing GM history is NOT RUN; clock validity implements 0.25-0.5 s; B.1's 5 s media-clock holdover is not a tu bound; periodic healthy samples alone cannot prove this; first discontinuity must be within observation_resolution_s of the rise; grade every GM change against the complete tu interval history; a GM change with no covering interval fails; true hold d is observed as h within +/- R, where R = observation_resolution_s; minimum accepts h + R >= 0.25 s, so d >= 0.25 s - 2 * R; require 2 * R < 0.25 s so an instant clear fails; upper bound requires h + R <= 0.5 s + R, equivalently h <= 0.5 s; resolution_limit_s is 0.125 s; coarser resolution is NOT RUN

clauses.soak.uptime-monotonic: REQUIREMENTS.md REQ-VER-06; issue #396 owner/assignment decisions: DUT uptime advances monotonically; reboot or unavailable uptime evidence cannot pass the continuous soak
